script.problem: Moment 2's passage 1 Kings 17:2-7 doesn't include a verse that names Tishbe in the lessons.

terra.problem: The line places Elijah’s speech to Ahab in Gilead, but 1 Kings 17:1 does not say where he spoke.
“Elijah speaks to Ahab” is not shown to happen at Tishbe. The verse does not give the location of their encounter.
“Sent to the Brook of Cherith” happens at the brook east of the Jordan, not at a location identified as Tishbe.
